Pro-Plantable Calendar (Wood) Eco-Friendly

The Pro-Plantable Calendar (Wood) Eco-Friendly is one of the most innovative, responsible, and nature-friendly desk accessories for homes, offices, and corporate gifting. Designed with sustainability at its core, this plantable calendar includes 12 seed-paper cards (7″×5″), each embedded with high-quality tomato, basil, and marigold seeds. The set comes with a beautifully crafted mini wooden easel (6″ tall) that serves as a natural and elegant stand for your monthly seed-paper cards. Every unit also provides easy-to-follow planting instructions, making it a perfect eco-friendly gifting choice.This seed paper calendar is ideal for individuals and businesses looking to reduce environmental impact while embracing modern, sustainable lifestyle choices. The eco-friendly calendar reduces waste and promotes green living by encouraging users to plant each month’s seed-paper card instead of discarding it. This makes the Pro-Plantable Calendar (Wood) a thoughtful and meaningful alternative to traditional desk calendars.

Whether you’re looking for sustainable corporate gifts, employee welcome kits, festive gifts, premium eco gifts, or environmentally conscious promotional items, this plantable calendar fits perfectly. The seed-paper cards are handmade using recycled cotton waste, ensuring minimal carbon footprint. The wooden easel brings a natural aesthetic appeal, making it a versatile desk décor accessory for workspaces, homes, cafés, studios, and creative environments.

Each month of this features premium-quality seed paper that sprouts into a lively plant when placed in soil and watered regularly. The tomato, basil, and marigold seeds are chosen for their easy germination and suitability for Indian climatic conditions, making this seed-paper calendar practical and rewarding for the user. With sustainability becoming a major trend in gifting, this stands out as a premium, responsible choice.

Key Features

  • Premium Pro-Plantable Calendar (Wood) Eco-Friendly edition
  • Includes 12 seed-paper cards (7″×5″) embedded with tomato, basil & marigold seeds
  • Comes with a mini wooden easel (6″ tall) for elegant display
  • Planting Instructions included with every pack
  • Perfect for eco-friendly gifts and sustainable corporate gifting
  • Handmade seed paper crafted from recycled cotton waste
  • Promotes zero-waste, biodegradable, plantable products
  • Ideal for desks, workspaces, home décor & corporate giveaway

A  goes beyond traditional use—it adds value by growing into plants that contribute to a greener environment. It supports eco-conscious lifestyles, reduces paper waste, and offers an interactive experience with nature. The edition is a smart step towards sustainable living while offering practicality, beauty, and purpose.

Its unique combination of seed-paper cards, wooden easel, and thoughtful design makes it one of the best options in the market today.
